disease_assertion.endpoint: spike-wave discharge rate per hour on continuous ECoG
disease_assertion.locator: disease-models/wwox/research/drug_repurposing/woree_rescue_reference_scaffold.md § 2.1, row E1 (Figure 7E at 400 dpi, vector page render)

context.disease_id: Wwox-null mouse model of WOREE (engineered null; NOT the Q230P class)
context.developmental_stage: about two to three weeks after birth

disease_assertion.measured_result_note: Wild-type versus knockout bracket marked highly significant; n = 5 pups per group by caption; blinded event screening declared for this panel; absence-type signature, not the convulsive repertoire of WOREE; the companion spike-count panel contradicts its own text (p value printed on the panel) and is a baseline, not a rescue measure.

drug_assertions.endpoint: spike-wave discharge rate per hour on continuous ECoG

context.disease_id: Wwox-null mouse model of WOREE (engineered null; NOT the Q230P class)
context.developmental_stage: about two to three weeks after birth

drug_assertions.measured_result_note: Treated knockout fell from a knockout level to a level not significantly different from wild type, at ONE vector level only: there is no low-level arm on this endpoint, so dose-dependence is NOT TESTED here and the measure must not be cited for a dose-dependent direction. Single-channel montage; limited cohort in the authors' words.

p4_fields.endpoint_pursued: Restoration of WWOX function by neuron-directed replacement; the single useful endpoint carried is spike-wave discharge rate. Other measured families (survival, growth and glycaemia, motor score, myelination, gliosis) are in p4_card and are NOT compared by the bridge, which holds one disease assertion per packet.
p4_fields.functional_evidence_available: In the Wwox-null mouse, by one laboratory: SWD rate to wild-type level (single vector level); survival to 300 days at the higher vector level; a graded motor score; graded glycaemia at one age; WWOX protein graded; myelination qualitative only; gliosis binary against wild type with no untreated-null comparator in the quantified treated panels.
p4_fields.temporal_or_model_limit: Constitutive null, not Q230P; one laboratory (the two papers share senior author and institution); no replication; earliest postnatal treatment ages only and NOT_MEASURED is not SMALLER; no tumour surveillance or overexpression-toxicity endpoint; SWD recorded over one week starting about two weeks after birth; threshold not located.

cellular_context.target_expression: Neuron-directed construct; WWOX protein graded by vector level and regionally uneven, supraphysiological in survivors and survivor-selected (PREMISE: NOBODY_LOOKED on the upper bound).
cellular_context.cells_tissue_stage: Mouse brain regions; the cerebellum, the organ of the ataxic phenotype, is the region the vector reaches least and no efficacy endpoint was measured there; protein also reaches the sciatic nerve while liver stays at background.
cellular_context.coverage: Oligodendrocyte-directed construct produced essentially no detectable protein, so the oligodendrocyte question is unanswered, not answered negatively.
cellular_context.limits: Residual partial function in a missense context is a reason to expect a DIFFERENT result, not a larger one; the expected level of rescue in the reference genotype does not follow from this study in either direction.

p4_card.identity: AAV9 carrying human WWOX cDNA under a neuronal promoter, with and without a post-transcriptional element; the promoter-comparison constructs are a different architecture. Whether any programme's clinical construct equals the mouse-study construct: UNKNOWN. Titre convention is undeclared by the source and no vector quantity is reproduced here.
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: WOREE (all genotypes carry some level of WWOX deficit) as target; origin: a constitutive-null mouse and human knockout and patient-derived organoids. Transfer to a Q230P-class missense or compound context is not established.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: Already studied (two mouse papers, one laboratory). A gene-therapy programme for WOREE is recorded at grant level (census § 3); that is not a registered study.
p4_card.state_of_known_roads: partial: the only measured rescue in the corpus, complete on several R-class endpoints, with no S, C or D datum.
p4_card.expected_contribution: Recovery of function by replacement (R-class demonstrated in the null mouse); nothing is stated for clinical benefit.
p4_card.mechanism: Target: WWOX gene dosage in neurons; type: replacement; direction: protein up; context: null mouse brain.

internal: CLAIM 002, CLAIM 004, CLAIM 011 (flagged for review, NOT consolidated), CLAIM 040, TX-007, DL-MOL-005, DIS-021, DIS-023
sources.note: Here the sources ARE WWOX evidence in the null mouse; the transfer to the reference genotype is the gap.

for: SWD to a level not distinguishable from wild type in the strongest causal design of the corpus (blinded; single vector level).
Durable survival to 300 days at the higher vector level, comparable to the wild-type arm (which itself lost about 29 percent).
Graded WWOX protein, glycaemia at one age and motor score.
against: Not independently replicated within the repository; the source's mouse-versus-human construct comparison is an intra-study control, and the human-organoid source was not tested here.

SURVIVAL IS A STEP IN THESE DATA, BUT A STEP AND A STEEP CONTINUUM ARE INDISTINGUISHABLE: the lower level postpones death and reaches extinction; two dose points cannot locate a threshold; the adjudication in CLAIM 011 reads the step as strengthened, not established.
Body weight is equal at the two levels at one age and the weight comparison is survivor-conditioned on the lower side: an equality between unequal denominators is not evidence of grading.
Myelination dose relation never quantified; gliosis result binary against wild type with no untreated-null comparator; SWD has no low-level arm.
No tumour surveillance of any kind in a pro-apoptotic tumour suppressor delivered irreversibly; no measured ceiling.
Treatment age window tested only at the earliest postnatal ages; later NOT_MEASURED.
Behaviour at 3 months has no untreated-null arm by construction and a text-versus-panel conflict, not adjudicated.
evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: Null versus missense or compound context; mouse absence-type SWD versus human convulsive repertoire.

p4_card.time_to_access: UNKNOWN. The census records a programme with a gene-therapy objective at grant level; no registered WOREE study; sponsor-declared authorisation, enrolment and first dose UNKNOWN.
p4_card.time_to_benefit: UNKNOWN in humans. In the mouse the SWD effect was recorded over one week starting about two weeks after birth; no earlier ECoG timepoint exists.
p4_card.pharmacology: Not applicable in the small-molecule sense: biodistribution regionally uneven; potency, selectivity and CNS exposure of a human product: UNKNOWN. The absolute vector quantity is uncertain by exactly a factor of two in the source and no figure is reproduced.
p4_card.paediatrics_and_interactions: UNKNOWN. No paediatric suitability is presumed by this card, for the candidate or for any historical authorisation of it for another use.

scope_of_checks.support_and_replication: One laboratory; no replication; support is intra-study.
scope_of_checks.formal_checks: Rescue-reference fill: voluntary blind audit run on the new Figure 3B triples, 5 SUPPORTED, 2 OVERSHOOT, 1 UNDERSHOOT, 0 UNVERIFIABLE, all adverse verdicts repaired at source; verdict not certified by its author. CLAIM 011 remains flagged for review.
scope_of_checks.card_inferences_owed_audit: None added; the survival wording follows the CLAIM 011 adjudication now in the claim registry (a step, with a step and a steep continuum indistinguishable, the step reading strengthened and not established).

question_history: CLAIM 011 flag of 2026-08-10 (dose-dependent over a threshold) -> NARROW adjudication CC-20261021-SCIENTIST-C-CLAIM011-DOSE-ADJUDICATION-01
p4_card.next_measurement: An intermediate-level arm, defined as a fraction of the primary's higher level (never in absolute quantity), carried to 300 days with survival, weight, glycaemia, ECoG and quantified myelin in the same animals; and an independent replication. Either would change whether this is a threshold or a steep continuum.
p4_card.status_reason: Transfer to the reference genotype not established; no replication.
p4_card.value_added: Shows which endpoints carry a graded relation and which do not, so a single useful endpoint is not read as a dose-response.
p4_card.clinical_census: Clinical census, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, 2026-10-20 (disease-models/wwox/research/drug_repurposing/clinical_census_20261020.md): seven separate queries returned no registered WOREE interventional study; the only synonym-driven record is one observational natural-history registry. Carried with the census's own caution: "A missing hit does not prove that no study exists." It answers seven queries against one registry on one date; unregistered, differently worded, non-NLM or later-registered studies are not excluded.

not_known: Whether a missense or compound context with partial residual function would respond more, less or differently.
The upper bound of safe expression and any tumour risk.
Whether treatment after the earliest postnatal ages helps less, equally or more.
The shape of the dose relation between the two tested vector levels.
Whether the source's result is reproduced by an independent laboratory.
evidence_against: Survival: a step and a steep continuum are indistinguishable; threshold not located.
No replication within the repository (two papers, one senior author and institution); the human-organoid AAV9-WWOX source was not tested for this claim.
reading_guard: OPPOSES_DISEASE_CHANGE is a sign comparison on ONE endpoint inside the Wwox-null mouse context. It says nothing about the Q230P class, nothing about the other endpoints (which the bridge does not compare), nothing about dose-dependence, and nothing about efficacy or safety in any person.

card_conventions: IPOTESI throughout; the bridge forces it. No score, rank, probability or blended index is carried, and none may be derived from this card.

directional_summary compares signs only where target, endpoint and every context dimension match; UNRESOLVED means no matched comparison exists, which is a statement about the record, not about the biology.
NO_MATCH_FOUND is not 'does not exist'; NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA is not MAI_TENTATO.
label_lookup is NOT_ATTEMPTED on every card: the bridge has no network and no pharmacological-label search was run. It is not NO_MATCH_FOUND.
No dose, route, schedule or paediatric suitability appears; concentrations or exposures of the sources are deliberately not reproduced.
Every adjacent source is labelled NOT WWOX EVIDENCE at class level.
no_new_reading: No paper was opened for this card; the sources are the repository's own receipted notes and records.
